$comment: GENERATED by wp/tests/wp-integration/mcp_abilities.sh from the abilities a running site registers (Pro on). Do not edit: WRITE_REGISTRY=1 regenerates it, and the harness fails when this file differs from the site.

mcp.auth: a WordPress application password (HTTP) or --user (WP-CLI); the user needs the capability each ability names
mcp.switch: Settings: Allow AI agents (MCP), on by default

rest.run: /wp-json/wp-abilities/v1/abilities/<name>/run  (GET with ?input= for read-only abilities, POST {"input": {...}} otherwise)

abilities.name: tranzly/bulk-translate
abilities.label: Translate the whole site
abilities.description: Starts background translation jobs for every original of the given content types (all translated types when none are given): the missing translations, the out-of-date ones, or all of them. Returns the jobs started, one per language.

abilities.name: tranzly/cancel-job
abilities.label: Cancel a job
abilities.description: Stops a job; translations already made are kept.

abilities.name: tranzly/check-quality
abilities.label: Check a translation with AI
abilities.description: Has AI compare one translation with its original and score it, and stores the report on the translation. Uses the quality-check AI model set in Tranzly's workflow settings.

abilities.name: tranzly/connect-support
abilities.label: Connect to support
abilities.description: Connects this site to Zinn Digital® support (name, email, consent).

abilities.name: tranzly/correct-segments
abilities.label: Correct a translation
abilities.description: Saves corrected segments of a translation (segments: key to text); corrected text is protected from re-translation.

abilities.name: tranzly/create-job
abilities.label: Start a translation job
abilities.description: Starts a background job translating listed posts (posts) or a whole post type into languages (langs).

abilities.name: tranzly/create-post-translation
abilities.label: Create an empty translation
abilities.description: Creates a draft translation of a post in a language (lang) to write by hand, without an engine.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: tranzly/create-term-translation
abilities.label: Create a term translation by hand
abilities.description: Creates a term's translation in a language with a name, slug and description you give.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: tranzly/disconnect-support
abilities.label: Disconnect from support
abilities.description: Disconnects this site from support.

abilities.name: tranzly/estimate
abilities.label: Estimate a translation
abilities.description: Estimates characters and cost to translate posts (posts or post_type) into languages (langs) with an engine, before spending anything.

abilities.name: tranzly/estimate-bulk
abilities.label: Estimate translating the site (Pro)
abilities.description: Estimates a whole-site translation in a language (post_types, scope, engine) before starting it.

abilities.name: tranzly/export-translation-file
abilities.label: Export a file for human translators
abilities.description: Returns an XLIFF or CSV file (as text) with the originals and their translations in one language, for a translator or a translation agency: the given posts, or a page of up to 100 originals of a content type in a state (missing, stale, translated or all; repeat with after). Import it back with tranzly/upload-translation-file.
abilities.capability: edit_posts; each post is included only if the user may edit it

abilities.name: tranzly/fix-status
abilities.label: Translate what is missing
abilities.description: Queues translation of every missing (or out-of-date) item in a language and post type.

abilities.name: tranzly/get-comments-setting
abilities.label: Read comment handling (Pro)
abilities.description: Returns whether comments are shared across languages or kept per language.

abilities.name: tranzly/get-deepl-usage
abilities.label: Read the DeepL usage
abilities.description: Returns the characters used and the limit of the saved DeepL key this month.

abilities.name: tranzly/get-diagnostics
abilities.label: Read the site diagnostics
abilities.description: Returns the diagnostics a support ticket would carry: versions, active plugins, limits and recent errors.

abilities.name: tranzly/get-display
abilities.label: Read the display options
abilities.description: Returns the language switcher and credit display options.

abilities.name: tranzly/get-engine-settings
abilities.label: Read the engine settings
abilities.description: Returns the default and fallback engine, per-language engines, each engine's state and this month's spend.

abilities.name: tranzly/get-glossary
abilities.label: Read the glossary
abilities.description: Returns the words never translated, the fixed term translations and the tone per language.

dnt.description: Words never translated (brand and product names).

terms.description: Per language code: source term => the translation always used.

tone.description: Per language code: formality (default, more, less) and style instructions.

abilities.name: tranzly/get-integrations
abilities.label: Read the integrations
abilities.description: Lists the SEO, WooCommerce, page-builder and form plugins Tranzly supports and which are active here.

abilities.name: tranzly/get-job
abilities.label: Read a job's progress
abilities.description: Returns one job's progress and counts.

abilities.name: tranzly/get-job-failures
abilities.label: Read a job's failures
abilities.description: Lists a job's failed items with the reason for each.

abilities.name: tranzly/get-legacy-import
abilities.label: Read the Tranzly 2.x import
abilities.description: Returns the state and report of importing translations from Tranzly 2.x.

abilities.name: tranzly/get-licence
abilities.label: Read the licence
abilities.description: Returns this site's Tranzly plan, licence state, renewal date and what the plan includes.

abilities.name: tranzly/get-menus
abilities.label: Read the menus per language
abilities.description: Returns which menu each language shows in each menu location.

abilities.name: tranzly/get-post-group
abilities.label: Read a post's translations
abilities.description: Lists a post's translation group: every language's member with its title, status and edit link.
abilities.capability: edit_post and edit_term (the REST route's own check)

abilities.name: tranzly/get-quality-report
abilities.label: Read a quality report (Pro)
abilities.description: Returns a translation's AI quality report: score and the segments it flagged.

abilities.name: tranzly/get-segments
abilities.label: Read a translation side by side
abilities.description: Returns a translation's segments beside the original's, for review and correction.

abilities.name: tranzly/get-shared-strings
abilities.label: Read theme and plugin texts
abilities.description: Returns the theme and plugin texts (scope) in a language with their translations.

abilities.name: tranzly/get-site-strings
abilities.label: Read the site's texts in a language
abilities.description: Returns the site title, tagline and widget texts in a language.

abilities.name: tranzly/get-support-connection
abilities.label: Read the support connection
abilities.description: Says whether this site is connected to Zinn Digital® support, and as whom.

abilities.name: tranzly/get-term-group
abilities.label: Read a term's translations
abilities.description: Lists a category's or tag's translation group.
abilities.capability: edit_post and edit_term (the REST route's own check)

abilities.name: tranzly/get-urls
abilities.label: Read the address settings
abilities.description: Returns how languages appear in addresses (folder, subdomain or domain), translated slugs and bases, and noindex for untranslated pages.

abilities.name: tranzly/get-workflow-settings
abilities.label: Read the workflow settings (Pro)
abilities.description: Returns auto-translation on publish and on update, review before publish, and the AI quality check's threshold, provider and model.

abilities.name: tranzly/import-from-source
abilities.label: Migrate from WPML, Polylang or TranslatePress (Pro)
abilities.description: Imports the next page of translations from another multilingual plugin (mode: dry-run or run; cursor).

abilities.name: tranzly/import-translation-file
abilities.label: Write an imported file (Pro)
abilities.description: Writes the next page of posts from an uploaded translation file (repeat with after until done).

abilities.name: tranzly/link-post
abilities.label: Link an existing post as a translation
abilities.description: Makes an existing post (target) the translation of this post in a language.
abilities.capability: edit_post and edit_term (the REST route's own check)

abilities.name: tranzly/link-term
abilities.label: Link an existing term as a translation
abilities.description: Makes an existing term (target) the translation of this term in a language.
abilities.capability: edit_post and edit_term (the REST route's own check)

abilities.name: tranzly/list-engines
abilities.label: List translation engines
abilities.description: Lists the translation engines, whether each is set up, and which one is used when none is named.

abilities.name: tranzly/list-import-sources
abilities.label: List plugins to migrate from (Pro)
abilities.description: Lists WPML, Polylang and TranslatePress data found on this site that can be imported.

abilities.name: tranzly/list-jobs
abilities.label: List translation jobs
abilities.description: Lists background translation jobs, newest first, with progress.

abilities.name: tranzly/list-languages
abilities.label: List languages
abilities.description: Lists the site's languages. The first one is the language the original content is written in.

abilities.name: tranzly/list-status-items
abilities.label: List what is missing or out of date
abilities.description: Lists originals with their translation state in a language (state: missing, stale, current), page by page.

abilities.name: tranzly/list-theme-strings
abilities.label: List theme and plugin text sources (Pro)
abilities.description: Lists the themes and plugins whose texts can be scanned for translation, and how many strings each has.

abilities.name: tranzly/open-support-ticket
abilities.label: Open a support ticket
abilities.description: Files a support ticket (subject, message, kind, email), with this site's diagnostics when the administrator agreed. It never creates a login or sends one.

abilities.name: tranzly/record-support-consent
abilities.label: Consent to support diagnostics
abilities.description: Records the administrator's consent to send diagnostics with support tickets.

abilities.name: tranzly/retry-job-item
abilities.label: Retry or hand off a failed item
abilities.description: Retries a failed item (action: retry, optionally with another engine) or marks it for translating by hand (action: by-hand).
abilities.capability: edit_post and manage_options (the REST route's own check)

abilities.name: tranzly/review-translation
abilities.label: Approve or reject a translation (Pro)
abilities.description: Approves a translation (and publishes it when the original is published) or sends it back (decision, note).

abilities.name: tranzly/run-legacy-import
abilities.label: Import Tranzly 2.x translations
abilities.description: Runs the 2.x import: dry-run (report only), run, or undo.

abilities.name: tranzly/scan-theme-strings
abilities.label: Scan a theme or plugin for texts (Pro)
abilities.description: Scans the next page of a component's PHP files for translatable texts (repeat with after until done).

abilities.name: tranzly/schedule-quality-check
abilities.label: Check translations with AI (Pro)
abilities.description: Schedules the AI quality check of the next page of a language's translations (or the given posts).

abilities.name: tranzly/seo-audit
abilities.label: Multilingual SEO audit (Pro)
abilities.description: Checks translations for missing SEO titles, descriptions, slugs and hreflang in a language, page by page.

abilities.name: tranzly/set-comments-setting
abilities.label: Change comment handling (Pro)
abilities.description: Shares comments across a post's translations or keeps them per language (mode).
abilities.capability: manage_options and moderate_comments (the REST route's own check)

abilities.name: tranzly/set-engine-key
abilities.label: Save an engine key
abilities.description: Saves the API key (and region for Microsoft) of DeepL, Google or Microsoft; empty removes it. Keys are stored encrypted and never returned.

abilities.name: tranzly/set-menus
abilities.label: Set the menus per language
abilities.description: Assigns a menu per language per location (map).

abilities.name: tranzly/set-protection
abilities.label: Protect or unlock a translation
abilities.description: Protects a translation from being overwritten by the engine (protected: true), or unlocks it.

abilities.name: tranzly/set-shared-strings
abilities.label: Correct theme and plugin texts
abilities.description: Saves corrected translations of theme and plugin texts (strings); they become protected.

abilities.name: tranzly/set-site-string
abilities.label: Translate a site text
abilities.description: Saves one site text (key) in a language, e.g. the site title or tagline.
abilities.capability: edit_theme_options and manage_options (the REST route's own check)

abilities.name: tranzly/set-urls
abilities.label: Change the address settings
abilities.description: Sets the address mode (mode), per-language domains, translated bases and segments, noindex_untranslated and slug suggestions.

abilities.name: tranzly/start-trial
abilities.label: Start the free Pro trial
abilities.description: Starts the 14-day Tranzly Pro trial for this site (no payment needed).

abilities.name: tranzly/translate-media-field
abilities.label: Translate an image's text
abilities.description: Saves an image's alt text, title or caption (field) in a language (lang).

abilities.name: tranzly/translate-post
abilities.label: Translate a post or page
abilities.description: Translates one post or page into one or more of the site's languages with a translation engine, creating each translation or updating it. New translations are drafts unless publish is true. A translation a person edited is skipped unless force is true.
abilities.capability: may translate that post (edit_post on it); edit_post on an existing translation; the type's publish capability to publish

languages.description: Language codes from tranzly/list-languages, e.g. de_DE, or just de when only one German is listed.

engine.description: An engine id from tranzly/list-engines; the default engine when omitted.

abilities.name: tranzly/translate-shared-strings
abilities.label: Translate missing theme and plugin texts
abilities.description: Translates the next page of untranslated theme and plugin texts in a language with the default engine (repeat with after until done).

abilities.name: tranzly/translate-site
abilities.label: Translate my site
abilities.description: A guided workflow: the agent checks the languages and engine, estimates the cost, and translates what is missing, asking before it spends or publishes.

languages.description: The languages to translate into, e.g. German and French.

abilities.name: tranzly/translate-term
abilities.label: Translate a category or tag
abilities.description: Translates one term (category, tag or product attribute) into a language (lang) with an engine, creating or updating its translation.
abilities.capability: the REST route's own per-item permission check

abilities.name: tranzly/translation-status
abilities.label: Translation status
abilities.description: With a post ID: each language's translation of that post, whether it is out of date, and who wrote it. Without one: how much of the site is translated, per language.
abilities.capability: edit_post on that post; edit_posts for the site summary

abilities.name: tranzly/unlink-post
abilities.label: Unlink a post from its translations
abilities.description: Takes a post out of its translation group; it keeps its language.
abilities.capability: edit_post and edit_term (the REST route's own check)

abilities.name: tranzly/unlink-term
abilities.label: Unlink a term from its translations
abilities.description: Takes a term out of its translation group.
abilities.capability: edit_post and edit_term (the REST route's own check)

abilities.name: tranzly/update-display
abilities.label: Change the display options
abilities.description: Changes the switcher (style, flags, names, placement) and the credit line.

abilities.name: tranzly/update-engine-settings
abilities.label: Change the engine settings
abilities.description: Sets the default engine, a fallback engine and per-language engines (default, fallback, per_lang). Per-language engines and fallback are Pro.

abilities.name: tranzly/update-glossary
abilities.label: Update the glossary
abilities.description: Replaces the parts of the glossary you send (words never translated, term translations, tone); parts you leave out are kept. Used by every engine from the next translation on.

dnt.description: Words never translated (brand and product names).

terms.description: Per language code: source term => the translation always used.

tone.description: Per language code: formality (default, more, less) and style instructions.

dnt.description: Words never translated (brand and product names).

terms.description: Per language code: source term => the translation always used.

tone.description: Per language code: formality (default, more, less) and style instructions.

abilities.name: tranzly/update-settings
abilities.label: Change languages and settings
abilities.description: Sets the site's languages (languages: list of code and name; the first is the original language), the front-end class prefix, and whether AI agents (MCP) are allowed.

abilities.name: tranzly/update-workflow-settings
abilities.label: Change the workflow settings (Pro)
abilities.description: Sets on_update (off, stale, translate), on_publish, review, quality_threshold, quality_provider and quality_model.

abilities.name: tranzly/upload-translation-file
abilities.label: Import a translated file (Pro)
abilities.description: Uploads a Tranzly XLIFF or CSV file (content, filename) translated elsewhere; answers a token for tranzly/import-translation-file.
